title: ALLROUND4YOU
tagline: The first website for a construction business that had only ever worked through referrals and WhatsApp.
summary: ALLROUND4YOU already had real projects and clients, just no website. The brief was simple: bring everything together in one place, so a prospective customer could see the work, understand the services, and get in touch directly.
role: End-to-end: structure, design, copy, development, domain and hosting
timeline: About 20 days, including revisions and back-and-forth
coverImageAlt: Renovated open-plan kitchen with exposed timber ceiling beams and pendant lighting, part of ALLROUND4YOU's completed work
problem: ALLROUND4YOU had never had a website. New clients mostly came through referrals, and everything after that happened over WhatsApp. What was missing was a simple way to show someone the services and finished work before the first conversation even started.
solution: I handled the whole project myself: structure, copy, design and development. The site covers the main service categories, photos of finished work, and direct ways to get in touch by phone or WhatsApp. I also set up the domain and hosting, so the client ended up with a working website, not just a design file.
collaboration: We stayed in close contact throughout. Details, photos and copy went through a few rounds of revisions along the way, about six in total.
outcome: The site is live on its own domain. The client now has a page he can send to a prospective customer instead of explaining the services and forwarding photos every time. He was happy with the result and said he'd recommend me to people he knows.
